display_name: Intel Movidius Myriad 2 VPU (pure-Rust 12-SHAVE NCSDK v1)

support.note: Linux x86_64 host with pure-Rust Movidius NCS1 (03e7:2150 / 03e7:f63b) USB VPU runtime

notes: movidius-rust (/codebase/repos/movidius-rust): pure-Rust MA2450 bootloader, SPARC V8 ELF unpacker, v1 graph dissector, and 12-SHAVE GEMM compiler.
Validates NCSDK v1 .graph checkpoints at load time and executes on attached 03e7:f63b Myriad 2 VPU sticks.
